actions.desc: The cat emits a soft, high-pitched meow at a creature it can see within 10 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 11 CHA save or be charmed until the end of its next turn. If a creature's save is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the cat's Charming Mewl for the next 24 hours.
